title: Addressing Bias in VLMs for Glaucoma Detection Without Protected Attribute Supervision

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Equalized-Odds Distance (EOD), Equalized Subgroup AUC (ES-AUC), and Group-wise AUC across racial groups (Asian, Black, White) for glaucoma detection on the Harvard-FairVLMed dataset.

Evaluating Equalized-Odds Distance (EOD), Equalized Subgroup AUC (ES-AUC), and Group-wise AUC across age groups (Young, Old) for glaucoma detection.
